name: Farah Al-Saleel (5-6)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.text:
A small ball of flame appears in the palm of your hand, and you lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a spell attack roll against your target's AC. This is normally a ranged attack, but you can also make a melee attack against a creature in your unarmed reach.

On a success, you deal 2d4 fire damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and @item.leveld4 persistent,fire damage.

---

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage on a critical hit by 1d4.

items.name: Bravery
items.text: Whenever Farah rolls a success at a Will save against a fear effect, she gets a critical success instead. In addition, any time she gains the frightened condition, she reduces its value by 1

rules.text: Whenever Farah rolls a success at a Will save against a fear effect, she gets a critical success instead.

items.name: Burning Grasp
items.text: When Farah grabs a creature, that creature takes 1d6 fire damage, and takes 1d6 fire damage at the end of each of its turns as long as it remains Grabbed.

items.name: Change Size
items.text:
Frequency once per day

---

Effect Farah changes a creature's size. This works as a 2nd-rank Enlarge or Shrink spell but can target an unwilling creature (DC 25 Fortitude save save negates).

items.name: Combat Grab
items.text:
Requirements Farah has one hand free

---

Effect Farah makes a melee Strike while keeping one hand free. If the Strike hits, the target is Grabbed in Farah's free hand.

text:
The efreet are hateful and merciless genies from the Plane of Fire, where they build metropolises and massive trade centers that draw extraplanar travelers from across the multiverse. They are cruel slavers, vengeful warmongers, and sinister wish-masters; there are many tales of mortals who made pacts with efreet only to have their words twisted to suit a genie's capricious and malevolent whims.

Efreet do not readily treat with other genies; they share an eternal feud with the djinn, disdain marids, regard jann as weaklings unworthy of the genie title, and only occasionally tolerate alliances with shaitans. At 12 feet tall and weighing 2,000 pounds, efreet are formidable opponents and cow their chosen victims with a glance.

---

A unique type of genie exists for each Elemental Plane, and the bodies of genies are formed out of elemental matter corresponding to their native plane: djinn are formed from wind, clouds, and storms; efreet are fire made flesh; marids are beings of water; and shaitans are composed of metal, gems, and stone. Lastly, the jann are formed out of all four elements, and are the weakest of geniekind.
